newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian woman arrested with wig full of cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Colombian woman arrested with wig full of cocaine.

text.p: A Colombian woman was arrested at Bogota's international airport as she prepared to board a flight for Rome wearing a wig full of cocaine, local news reports said on Thursday.

Bogota's El Espectador newspaper said the woman was found to be carrying 2.2 pounds (one kg) of cocaine in a helmet-like device covered with a wig and glued to her scalp. Airport police could not be reached immediately for comment on the report.
